mapper.select:
select a.mst_cd ,a.mst_nm ,a.use_yn ,a.remark ,a.attr1 ,a.attr2 ,a.attr3 from tb_common_code_mst a where 1=1
and a.mst_cd like CONCAT('%', #{mst_cd}, '%')
and a.mst_nm like CONCAT('%', #{mst_nm}, '%')
select a.mst_cd ,a.dtl_cd ,a.dtl_nm ,a.use_yn ,a.remark ,a.attr1 ,a.attr2 ,a.attr3 from tb_common_code_dtl a where a.mst_cd = #{mst_cd}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_common_code_dtl (mst_cd, dtl_cd, dtl_nm, use_yn, remark, attr1, attr2, attr3) values (#{mst_cd}, #{dtl_cd}, #{dtl_nm}, #{use_yn}, #{remark}, #{attr1}, #{attr2}, #{attr3})
